name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Staff Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with 25+ years of experience delivering scalable, service-oriented platforms and modernizing complex enterprise systems. Proven track record designing distributed architectures, integrating partner and internal APIs, building resilient backend services, and mentoring engineering teams across time zones. Strong hands-on engineering background in Java, .NET, cloud-native platforms, DevOps, and system modernization with a focus on performance, reliability, and business impact.
